question: Should OpenClaw permanently support ordered, immutable `--config-layer` composition as a core Gateway startup contract for managed hosts?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally opt-in and has evidence of bounded behavior, but accepting its long-lived CLI, upgrade, mutation, and support semantics is a product and ownership decision rather than a mechanical correctness judgment.

options.title: Sponsor bounded core support
options.body: Accept the documented V1 contract, refresh it against current main, and merge after final-head Gateway lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep composition host-owned
options.body: Decline the permanent core CLI and have managed launchers compose or govern their inputs outside OpenClaw instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded core support
recommendation.body: Accept the documented V1 contract, refresh it against current main, and merge after final-head Gateway lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Explicitly mentioned at proposal opening and therefore the strongest available routing signal in the provided review context.
